name: Sayri Desktop UI
author: jaimegh-es
description: The Sayri desktop UI: the GTK4/WebKit assistant window, tray icon, overlay and full conversation interface. Running `sayri ui default` launches this plugin.

ui.name: Sayri Desktop UI
ui.sync_instructions: Sayri's main desktop UI. Launch it anytime with `sayri ui default` (or `sayri ui desktop`). It connects to the Sayri daemon over IPC and shows the assistant overlay and tray.
